description: Apple’s iPhone 18 Pro series may arrive in grey, silver, and dark red, according to a new leak with renders. The dark red option could mark the return of a red iPhone since 2022. Reports suggest Apple is testing new finishes enabled by its aluminium design. The lineup may skip a black variant again. The phones are expected to launch in September with a 2nm A20 Pro chip, a battery above 5,000mAh, and improved cameras, though details remain unconfirmed.
title: No More Black? iPhone 18 Pro New Leak Reveals Bold New Colour Options for 2026

description: Apple is widely rumoured to introduce its first-ever foldable iPhone, dubbed iPhone Fold, in 2026. It is expected to be announced alongside the iPhone 18 Pro models during Apple’s September launch event, although the tech giant has yet to confirm the handset. Ahead of its anticipated debut, industry sources reportedly suggest that the trial production of the handset has begun. The purported iPhone Fold’s shipments are expected to begin later this year.
title: iPhone Fold Trial Production Begins Ahead of Anticipated Launch in H2 2026: Report

description: Samsung Galaxy S27 series will include a Pro model, in addition to the Galaxy S27, Galaxy S27+, and Galaxy S27 Ultra, according to a report citing industry sources. Dubbed Samsung Galaxy S27 Pro, the handset is said to arrive with similar features to the rumoured Galaxy S27 Ultra. However, it will reportedly not ship with support for the S Pen stylus. The flagship Galaxy S27 lineup is expected to launch next year, succeeding the current Galaxy S26 series, which includes the Galaxy S26, Galaxy S26+, and Galaxy S26 Ultra.
title: Samsung Galaxy S27 Pro to Reportedly Launch Next Year With the Privacy Display Feature

description: WhatsApp is reportedly rolling out a noise cancellation feature for voice and video calls to Android beta users. The feature is said to be available in the WhatsApp beta for Android 2.26.14.1. Designed to minimise background noise in real time without affecting the speaker’s voice, the feature aims to improve call clarity. It is expected to be especially useful in noisy or outdoor environments. Users can disable it from the calling menu.
title: WhatsApp Reportedly Rolls Out Noise Cancellation for Voice and Video Calls to Android Beta Users

description: Jack Dorsey’s decentralised messaging app Bitchat has been removed from Apple’s China App Store following regulatory concerns raised by Chinese authorities. The app, which operates without internet using Bluetooth mesh networks, was flagged for its potential to influence public opinion. Despite the removal, it remains available globally and has gained traction in regions facing internet restrictions.
title: China Removes Bitchat App From Apple Store Over Regulatory Concerns

description: Created by Karan Anshuman and Karmanya Ahuja, , Glory is an upcoming sports crime thriller series that is soon landing on Netflix. It stars Pulkit Samrat and Divyendu Sharma in the lead roles.
title: Glory OTT Release Confirmed: Where to Watch Pulkit Samrat and Divyendu Sharma Starrer Online

description: Meta is reportedly laying off as many as 200 employees amid the company’s ongoing artificial intelligence (AI) transformation. As per the report, these layoffs impact the company’s US-based teams and not the global offices. Additionally, the social media giant is reportedly planning to phase out the middle manager positions to make the teams leaner and the hierarchy streamlined.
title: Meta to Fire 200 Employees, Phase Out Middle Manager Titles Amid AI Push: Report

description: Oppo has revealed new camera details for the Find X9 Ultra ahead of its April 21 launch. The phone will feature a built-in telephoto lens with up to 10x optical zoom, developed with Hasselblad. An executive described this as a “built-in teleconverter” designed for quick, everyday use that covers most shooting needs. Oppo is also developing an external telephoto kit with 16 optical elements for professional use. The system combines internal and external optics to improve image quality and balance convenience with advanced photography.
title: Oppo Find X9 Ultra to Feature 10x Optical Zoom and External Lens Kit

description: China is encouraging banks to adopt blockchain technology to enable secure sharing of tax data and improve lending processes. The initiative is expected to enhance transparency, reduce fraud risks, and make credit more accessible, especially for small businesses. It also reflects the country’s focus on using blockchain in regulated financial systems.
title: China Urges Banks to Use Blockchain for Lending, Tax Data Sharing

description: In an exclusive chat with Gadgets 360, the Realme CMO discusses why entry-level phones are seeing a price jump and the strategy to retain its youth audience.
title: Realme's Wong on the 16 5G Launch and the Industry Price Surge: "Value Must Rise Faster Than Prices"

description: Crimson Desert has received yet another update that brings a host of gameplay improvements and bug fixes. Patch 1.02.00 adds expanded private storage capacity, headgear visibility option, graphics and UI improvements, and much more. Crimson Desert launched on March 19 and has since sold over 4 million copies.
title: Crimson Desert Gets New Patch With Extra Storage Capacity, Headgear Visibility Option and More Improvements

description: Meta has reportedly paused all work with artificial intelligence (AI) recruitment company Mercor after the company was hit by a cyberattack last week. As per the report, the Menlo Park-based tech giant was among the biggest clients of the startup that hires subject matter experts to validate and run quality analysis on large language models’ output.
title: Meta Reportedly Halts Work With AI Partner Mercor After Data Breach Incident

description: Thaai Kizhavi is a Tamil comedy-drama releasing on JioHotstar, focusing on family emotions and greed.
title: Thaai Kizhavi OTT Release Date: When and Where to Watch it Online?

description: A workaholic hotel manager finds love and healing through an unexpected bond with her doctor neighbor.
title: The Best Thing Now Available for Streaming Online: Where to Watch, Plot, Cast, and More

description: A charismatic man and an independent woman navigate love, ego, and destiny in a gripping tale of pride and passion.
title: Rubaab OTT Release: Where to Watch This Marathi Film Online?

description: Infinix Note 60 Pro will be available for purchase in India in three colour options, dubbed Deep Ocean Blue, Mocha Brown, and Solar Orange, the Chinese smartphone maker has revealed. The dedicated microsite for the handset was also updated by the company to reveal the design of the phone. The handset is confirmed to go on sale in the country via Flipkart and the Infinix India online store. The tech firm recently teased that its Note 60 Pro will be equipped with an Active Matrix Display on the back panel, which appears to be inspired by Nothing’s Glyph Matrix interface.
title: Infinix Note 60 Pro Design, Colour Options Revealed as India Launch Nears

description: Oppo F33 Pro is tipped to be launched on April 14 in India. It will reportedly be priced under Rs. 35,000 in the country. It is said to come with a dual rear camera unit headlined by a 50-megapixel primary sensor and a 50-megapixel front-facing camera. The Oppo F33 Pro could feature a 6.57-inch flat AMOLED display and an IP69K-rated build for dust and water resistance. It is said to run on a MediaTek 6360 Max chipset. It could pack a 7,000mAh battery with 80W charging support.
title: Oppo F33 Pro India Launch Date, Price Range Leaked Online; Tipped to Feature 50-Megapixel Selfie Camera

description: Samsung’s upcoming Galaxy Z Fold 8, Galaxy Z Flip 8, Galaxy Z Wide Fold, and the rumoured Galaxy Buds Able have appeared on India’s BIS certification database, signalling progress toward launch. Battery units linked to these devices have been listed, along with a few unidentified models. Leaks suggest 5,000mAh batteries with 45W charging for the Fold 8 and Wide Fold, and a 4,300mAh battery with 25W charging for the Flip 8. The Wide Fold may feature a new 4:3 aspect ratio.
title: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8, Flip 8, Wide Fold Batteries Reportedly Certified on BIS Alongside Buds Able

description: Astronomers have discovered that fast-spinning pulsars emit radio waves far beyond their magnetic poles, reaching the edges of their magnetic fields. The finding challenges long-held theories and could help scientists discover more pulsars and improve gravitational wave detection.
title: New Study Claims There Might Be Way More Pulsars in Space Than We Previously Thought

description: The iQOO 15 Apex Edition is now available for purchase in India. The handset was launched last week as a new colourway of the iQOO 15. It only carries cosmetic changes on the surface, while the core experience remains the same as the standard model introduced in November 2025. The iQOO 15 Apex Edition sports a 6.85-inch display with 2K resolution and 144Hz refresh rate. It packs a 7,000mAh battery.
title: iQOO 15 Apex Edition With Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 SoC Goes on Sale in India: Price, Offers

description: Moto Razr Fold was previewed at the MWC 2026 last month. During the unveiling, Motorola confirmed that the device will soon be available in select markets. Now, the company has started teasing the arrival of the phone in Chinese and European markets. In the UK, the phone will be available for pre-order later this week. It is currently up for pre-reservations in China. The Moto Razr Fold has an 8.1-inch internal display and a 6.6-inch cover screen. It is equipped with a Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 chipset.
title: Moto Razr Fold Set to Launch Soon in Select Global Markets; UK Pre-Reservations to Start This Week

description: Red Magic will launch the Gaming Tablet 5 Pro in China in April or May 2026, and the exact date will be shared later. The tablet will succeed the Gaming Tablet 3 Pro and may see a global release after China, possibly under a different name. It is expected to feature an OLED display with a high refresh rate, a Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset, improved cooling, and a new UI. Pricing may increase due to rising component costs.
title: Red Magic Gaming Tablet 5 Pro Launch Timeline Revealed

description: Xiaomi 17 Max will be launched by the Chinese smartphone maker in May, a tipster claims. The handset, which will join the Xiaomi 17, Xiaomi 17 Pro Max, Xiaomi 17 Pro, and Xiaomi 17 Ultra, is said to be the last handset to arrive as part of the lineup. Additionally, the Max model is said to be priced higher than the standard model, which was launched in India earlier this year, in March. The phone will reportedly be powered by Qualcomm’s flagship octa core Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset, which is built on a 3nm process. It is said to carry a triple rear camera unit.
title: Xiaomi 17 Max Launch Timeline, Price Range Tipped Along With Key Specifications, Features

description: Redmi A7 Pro 5G will be launched in India this month, the Xiaomi sub-brand announced on Monday. While details remain under wraps, it is teased to sport a large and smooth display. The handset will pack a 6,300mAh battery, which is claimed to be the largest in its segment. On the software front, the Redmi A7 Pro 5G will run on HyperOS 3 based on Android 16. It is said to be equipped with a 32-megapixel dual rear camera system.
title: Redmi A7 Pro 5G India Launch Date Announced; Design, Key Features Teased

description: A security researcher claims North Korean IT workers have been involved in building and infiltrating DeFi platforms for years. The revelation follows a major exploit linked to a DPRK group and highlights growing concerns over state-backed cyber threats. Experts warn that such operations rely on long-term social engineering and insider access to compromise critical systems.
title: IT Workers From North Korea Have Been Infiltrating DeFi Platforms for Past 7 Years

description: NASA’s Artemis 2 mission is historic for several reasons. It is the first time in 50 years that the space agency has sent a crewed spacecraft into deep space. It is also its first lunar mission in the 21st century. Interestingly, this is also the first time the US space agency has cleared an iPhone for a deep space mission.
title: iPhone 17 Pro Max Cleared for Artemis 2 Mission: How NASA Approved It for This Deep Space Mission

description: Realme 16 5G is now on sale in India, the Chinese smartphone maker announced on Monday. The handset is available for purchase in the country via Flipkart and the Realme India online store. The new Realme 16 5G, the third model in the company’s Realme 16 series, is offered in Air Black and Air White colour options. Moreover, it is available in 8GB + 128GB, 8GB + 256GB, and 12GB + 256GB RAM and storage configurations. The smartphone is powered by a MediaTek Dimensity 6400 Turbo chipset, coupled with a 7,000mAh battery. It also carries a dual rear camera unit.
title: Realme 16 5G With 7,000mAh Battery, 50-Megapixel Rear Camera Goes on Sale in India: Price, Offers

description: Take-Two Interactive has laid of its artificial intelligence team, including the head of AI. Luke Dicken, Take-Two's former head of AI, confirmed the cuts in a LinkedIn post on Friday. The number of employees impacted by the layoffs is unclear. Take-Two is the parent company of Rockstar Games, currently developing Grand Theft Auto 6.
title: Rockstar Games Parent Take-Two Lays Off AI Team, Including Head of AI

description: Bitcoin traded near $69,000 on April 6 as mixed signals from macro factors, ETF flows, and on-chain data kept the market range-bound. Analysts pointed to weak spot demand and rising leverage, indicating a fragile setup. Altcoins showed selective gains, but broader sentiment remained cautious as investors awaited clearer directional triggers.
title: Bitcoin Trades Near $69,000 as Mixed Signals Keep Market Range-Bound

description: Netflix will offer live coverage of the Artemis II lunar flyby. Viewers in India can watch live starting 10:30pm IST today (April 6). It will also be streamed via the NASA+, Amazon Prime, Apple TV, Hulu, Netflix, HBO Max and Roku starting at 1:00pm Eastern Time, alongside the agency's coverage on its YouTube channel. During the lunar flyby, Orion is set to break the record for the farthest distance from Earth ever travelled by humans, surpassing the Apollo 13 milestone from April 1970.
title: Artemis II Lunar Flyby: Here’s How to Watch NASA’s Historic Mission Live on Netflix, Prime Video, and More

description: Netflix has been ordered by a Rome court to refund subscribers in Italy after past price hikes were ruled unlawful. The decision covers increases from 2017 to 2024, with refunds of up to EUR 500 (roughly Rs. 53,600). The court found Netflix did not clearly justify the changes in its contracts. It also directed the company to lower current prices and inform users within 90 days or face penalties. Netflix said it will challenge the ruling.
title: Netflix Ordered to Refund Up to EUR 500 Over Unlawful Price Hikes in Italy

description: Samsung has announced that Samsung Messages will be discontinued in July 2026. The company shared the update on its US support page. Users will be notified about the shutdown date on the Samsung Messages app on their devices. Samsung is fully transitioning to Google Messages as its default texting platform. The Samsung Messages is still available on the Galaxy Store.  Older Samsung Galaxy Watch models with Tizen OS cannot support Google Messages.
title: Samsung Confirms Deadline for Samsung Messages App: Here’s What You Will Use Instead

description: Casio has listed the AE-1600HX-1BV and AE-1600HX-3AV digital watches globally, with sales expected in April 2026. Pricing is yet to be announced, but retailer listings suggest around EUR 33.25 (roughly Rs. 3,600). Both models feature large LCD screens, dual time, stopwatch, countdown timer, alarms, and an LED backlight. They offer 100m water resistance and a 10-year battery life. Built with resin, the watches measure 54.1 × 49.7 × 15.9 mm and weigh 55g.
title: Casio AE-1600HX Series Launched With Dual Time Tracking, Up to 10 Years of Battery Life

description: Apple’s desktop computers, which are powered by the Cupertino-based tech giant’s proprietary M-series processors, will now support external GPUs (eGPUs), according to the tech firm Tiny Corp. The company claims that Apple has provided its approval for its drivers, which can now be used to support eGPUs on Mac devices. Tiny Corp also said that Mac computers will now support both AMD and Nvidia eGPUs via its drivers. This comes nearly half a decade after Apple introduced the first Apple Silicon M-series processor, while also removing support for eGPUs.
title: Apple Silicon-Powered Mac Devices Now Support eGPU, Tiny Corp Announces

description: Microsoft has been aggressively pushing Copilot, its in-house artificial intelligence (AI) technology, as a powerful productivity tool for enterprises. The Redmond-based tech giant recently released an automation tool dubbed Copilot Cowork, a wellbeing product called Copilot Health, and new native large language models (LLMs). However, despite the push, the AI chatbot’s terms of use describe it as an entertainment tool, which has started a debate online.
title: Microsoft’s Copilot Terms of Use Says the AI Chatbot Is for Entertainment Purposes Only

description: OpenAI is said to be undergoing a major leadership reshuffle. According to a report, longtime Chief Operating Officer (COO) Brad Lightcap is transitioning into a new role focused on special projects. Meanwhile, two other senior executives have reportedly stepped back due to health concerns. The development comes at a time when the company is expanding its enterprise business and exploring new revenue streams, building upon the completion of its latest funding round.
title: OpenAI Undergoes Leadership Shake-Up as COO Brad Lightcap Moves to Special Projects Role: Report

description: After years of development, Apple is finally expected to foray into the foldable smartphone market with the iPhone Fold. The handset, which could also be known as the iPhone Ultra, is rumoured to launch alongside the iPhone 18 Pro models later this year. While Apple has yet to officially confirm the handset, a latest rumour coming out of China sheds light on its build quality. It is tipped to leverage 3D printing technology for the hinge.
title: iPhone Fold Tipped to Use 3D Printed Hinge to Achieve Minimal Crease

description: Oppo is said to be preparing to enter the compact tablet space. We now have more details about the tablet, courtesy of a tipster. The purported tablet is believed to be called the Oppo Pad Mini. It could sport a sub-9-inch display with a different aspect ratio compared to traditional tablets. The Oppo Pad Mini could be powered by Qualcomm’s mid-flagship Snapdragon chipset. It is tipped to pack an 8,000mAh battery.
title: Oppo Pad Mini Tipped to Feature 144Hz OLED Screen, Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 Chipset: Expected Specifications
